cands.name: Richard (Todd) Carver
cands.bio: Republican member of the North Carolina House for District 95 since January 2025. Served in the U.S. Air Force from 1990 to 1994. Worked in law enforcement. Served on the Iredell-Statesville Board of Education (District 7) from 2018 to 2022.
cands.gaps: We could not find where Carver was born or raised, or when he moved to North Carolina. We found no statements from him on data centers, development, property taxes, immigration, guns, abortion, schools or policing, and no completed candidate surveys. His sponsored-bill list did not load, so we could not describe any bills he sponsored. We found no documented controversies, foreign ties or endorsements. We also could not confirm his law enforcement employers or roles, or the dates of his move to the district.
